categories.main_business_segments: Dongguan Eontec Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of new materials including liquid metal, magnesium alloy, aluminum alloy, medical materials, and polymer materials. Its products serve sectors such as new energy vehicles, consumer electronics, medical devices, 5G communications, and intelligent manufacturing. The company operates a complete industrial chain integrating material development, precision mold design, casting, CNC machining, and surface treatment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as large-scale vacuum die casting for magnesium-aluminum alloys, precision mold design, CNC machining, and surface treatment. It holds proprietary patents in liquid metal (amorphous alloy) composition, melting, precision molding, and vacuum forming equipment. The firm also pioneers in integrated die casting technology for lightweight automotive parts and has developed biodegradable medical magnesium alloy implants with clinical trial approvals.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international new energy vehicle manufacturers like Tesla, BYD, Huawei, and major automotive parts suppliers such as Bosch and ZF. It also serves consumer electronics brands including Lenovo, HP, and GoPro, as well as medical device companies and 5G communication equipment providers like Ericsson and Huawei. The markets span automotive, consumer electronics, medical devices, 5G infrastructure, and sports equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Dongguan, Shenzhen, and other cities. It has overseas subsidiaries and cooperates with international clients and partners, including in the US and Europe. Its export sales account for over 30% of revenue, serving global markets especially in automotive and consumer electronics sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dongguan Eontec operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on material development, precision casting, machining, and assembly of intermediate products such as automotive components, electronic structural parts, and medical implants. It provides one-stop industrial chain services from R&D to production and after-sales, positioning itself as a core supplier to OEMs and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in liquid metal materials, integrated die casting for new energy vehicles, and biodegradable medical magnesium alloys. It invests heavily in innovation platforms, collaborates with top research institutes, and continuously expands patent portfolios. Future R&D focuses include high-performance amorphous alloys, high-strength and high-thermal-conductivity aluminum alloys for 5G, and clinical translation of medical magnesium implants.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precision cast and machined products including magnesium and aluminum alloy components, liquid metal products, silicone materials, and molds. The company operates on an order-based production model, fulfilling customized contracts for automotive, electronics, and medical customers. It also receives government subsidies and occasional investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in new materials for automotive lightweighting, liquid metal applications, and biodegradable medical magnesium alloys. It holds a strong market position as a core supplier to major OEMs and system integrators, with proprietary technologies and patents. Competitors include other advanced materials and precision casting firms, but Dongguan Eontec differentiates through integrated capabilities and early adoption of large-scale die casting equipment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.65 billion, a slight decline of 3.19% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders dropping by 70.49% to about RMB 1 million due to pricing pressures and increased safety investments. It maintains total assets around RMB 2.74 billion and equity of about RMB 1.09 billion. Despite profit challenges, the company sustains positive cash flow and continues investing in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dongguan Eontec emphasizes its unique integrated industrial chain from material innovation to precision manufacturing, enabling high-quality, high-precision, and lightweight components tailored for new energy vehicles, consumer electronics, and medical devices. Its proprietary liquid metal and biodegradable magnesium alloy technologies offer superior performance, environmental benefits, and cost advantages. The company’s strong R&D, patent portfolio, and close customer collaboration provide competitive differentiation and industry leadership.
